name: Default
shortDescription: Blender 3D creation suite streamed to the browser behind a password, with preferences, add-ons and projects kept on a persistent volume and CPU rendering.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and anyone who signs in gets passwordless sudo inside the container. Save projects under /config so they persist.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
On arm64 servers this image installs the older Blender package from the Ubuntu repositories instead of the release in the image tag; x86_64 servers get the current release.
